subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should OpenClaw ship structured questions, plan mode, and autonomous goal mode together, and should update_plan become default-on for every model while adding the new goalDriver configuration surface?
rationale: Correctness review cannot choose a broad core interaction rollout, a changed tool default, and a permanent configuration and API contract; these require product and ownership intent.

options.title: Split and stage
options.body: Land question infrastructure first, plan mode second, and the experimental goal driver last after each layer has focused compatibility, security, and real-behavior proof.

options.title: Land the combined system
options.body: Accept the unified three-mode product and changed defaults in one release after the blocker, conflicts, channel proof, and owner reviews are resolved.

options.title: Preserve current defaults
options.body: Land selected interaction surfaces while keeping update_plan under its existing enablement policy and deferring autonomous continuation configuration.

recommendation.title: Split and stage
recommendation.body: Land question infrastructure first, plan mode second, and the experimental goal driver last after each layer has focused compatibility, security, and real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this owner to the goal, Codex bridge, tool-policy, enforcement, and Control UI decision surfaces needed for the rollout choice.
